in_marathi.name: Danraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of the gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Danraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Danraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘dan’ (gift) and ‘raj’ (ruler). According to Hindu mythology, Danraj was a name given to the celestial beings who bestowed boons upon the devotees. It signifies the blessings and grace of the divine.
